text_5052ed3d9c64: When a stop is detected, the application searches the locally available DS100 coordinates for the nearest station or reporting point within 1,000 metres. An unambiguous result prefills the location field with its code and name and is saved locally. Check the suggestion and change it if needed. Your own location entries are preserved. If the two nearest entries differ in distance by less than 25 metres, the field remains open for manual selection. Suggestions also work offline. Without a match, enter the location yourself; recording continues. Later updates take new catalogue data into account. Manual stops need an actual accurate GPS fix within 30 seconds of their start; no location is invented across a GPS gap. Demo playback and read-only recordings remain unchanged. This lookup does not share your position with other drivers. Only Transfer adds the stop to the journey details.
text_256112e9f9f2: Detected GPS stops receive an editable DS100 location suggestion from the nearest stored reference coordinates.
